g.text: N=3 independent pair(s), 6 started tasks, 6 successful | 2 cycles/task | 30.0s synthetic wait | 8 MiB probe
Exploratory sample: repeated cycles are not independent tasks; plotted gates are unchanged.
Scope: synthetic wait; full-RAM oracle; assigned-process PSS; nested Linux node. Physical host saving is unverified.
Memory includes provider/storage processes and observed descendants, including warm runtimes. Node page cache is a separate cost; PSS is not total host RAM.
